name: Key Lime Coins

ingredients.name: lime zest, from about 4 small key limes
lime juice, from about 4 small key limes

instructions.primary_message: In a small bowl, whisk together flour and salt; set aside. In a large bowl, cream together butter, sugar, and confectioners sugar until creamy, about 3 minutes. Beat in vanilla, egg yolk, juice, and zest until combined. Add flour and salt mixture and beat just until dough comes together. Form dough into two 4-cm wide logs and wrap in plastic wrap. Let chill in refrigerator at least one hour.

Adjust oven rack to middle and upper positions and preheat oven to 175°C (350°F). Line two baking sheets with parchment paper. Slice logs into 0.5-cm coins. Bake until coins are just golden on the bottom, about 20 minutes. Let cool for 5 minutes then transfer to a wire rack to finish cooling.

schema_metadata.keywords: cookie monster, Cookies, key limes, sables

description: These buttery shortbread coins are flavored with sweet-tart key limes.
notes: Total time, including resting: 1 hr 40 min.
author: Carrie Vasios Mullins
